description: This file is a Yocto bitbake include (.inc) file for configuring the Chromium GN build. It specifies recipes dependencies, build arguments, patches, and build steps for the Chromium project within a Yocto environment.

methods.name: get_compiler_flag
methods.description: Extracts the value of a specific compiler flag from a list of arguments.

methods.name: do_create_v8_qemu_wrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script to run target-specific V8 binaries under QEMU on the host.

methods.name: do_check_llvm_version
methods.description: Checks that the LLVM version used for the build meets the minimum requirement.

methods.name: do_write_toolchain_file
methods.description: Generates a BUILD.gn file for the Yocto toolchains used during Chromium build.

methods.name: do_add_nodejs_symlink
methods.description: Creates a symlink to the node binary for Chromium's build system to find.

methods.name: do_add_clang_latest
methods.description: Copies the latest Clang directory into a predictable location to ensure consistent linkage.

methods.name: do_copy_clang_library
methods.description: Copies the libclang_rt.builtins.a library from the host staging directory to the native sysroot.

methods.name: do_copy_target_rustlibs
methods.description: Copies Rust standard libraries for the target architecture into the native sysroot.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Runs GN to generate build files with specified arguments.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Builds Chromium using ninja with parallel jobs.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built Chromium binaries and resources into the destination directory.
